HeartGold & SoulSilver series · UD

HS—Undaunted

Released August 18, 2010 · 91 cards

HS—Undaunted is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, released in English on August 18, 2010. Its main set has 90 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (91 in total). It includes 80 Pokémon, 9 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

33 illustrators worked on HS—Undaunted. Most cards: Kagemaru Himeno (8), Masakazu Fukuda (5), Midori Harada (5), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), Hideaki Hakozaki (4), kawayoo (4), Kouki Saitou (4), match (4).
